Smolder

the Fiery Fledgling

Smolder is a young dragon who grows stronger with every stack of Dragon Practice. His Super Scorcher Breath gains explosions, burns and eventually an execute as he stacks. Safe early, very strong late if he farms well. He got buffs in 26.20 and 26.22.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

Buffed in patch 26.22: His W explosion hits harder at every rank, helping both crit and caster builds.
  • W explosion damage: 10/35/60/85/110 → 25/50/75/100/125 (+50% bonus AD) (+80% AP)
All patch changes →

When to pick Smolder

✓ Safe blind pick

Mostly. His long range keeps him safe, but all-in lanes can punish his weak early game.

Pick into

  • Passive lanes that let him stack, like Ezreal and Kalista
  • Long games where he scales with Dragon Practice
  • Grouped teams for his ultimate

Avoid into

  • All-in lanes with hard crowd control
  • Hyper-scaling marksmen like Twitch and Kog'Maw
  • Lane bullies like Miss Fortune who keep him from stacking

Great teammates

ThreshThresh protects him while he stacks.
LeonaLeona's engage helps him land abilities.
NamiNami's sustain and crowd control help him scale.

Your team needs: Pick Smolder when your team can protect him early and play for a long game.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Huge late-game scaling with Dragon Practice stacks
  • Flap, Flap, Flap lets him fly over walls to escape
  • MMOOOMMMM! deals big area damage and can heal him
  • Long-range abilities make him safe in lane

Weaknesses

  • Weak early before he gets stacks
  • Needs to farm a lot to scale; a lost lane hurts him badly
  • Vulnerable to all-in lanes with hard crowd control
  • Can be burst down if caught while Flap, Flap, Flap is on cooldown

Power spikes

  • 25 stacks: Q also hits enemies around your target, making wave clear much faster
  • First item (Essence Reaver): mana and damage for stacking
  • Two items (Black Cleaver): shreds armor for your whole team
  • 125 stacks: Q sends explosions out behind the target, hitting whole groups in fights
  • Three items (Spear of Shojin): lower cooldowns and more ability damage
  • 225 stacks: Q burns for true damage and executes low-health champions

Top tips

  • Farm with Q to stack Dragon Practice
  • Poke champions with W: it gives stacks too
  • Use E to escape over walls; it's your only escape
  • Your ultimate heals you if its center passes over you
  • Play safe early; you scale late
  • Track your stacks: 25, 125 and 225 are your big milestones
